scope_note: Long-term effectiveness cannot be inferred from this meta-analysis because follow-up evidence was sparse and inconsistent.
statement: The 2016 meta-analysis restricted its synthesis to short-term outcomes because few studies reported long-term outcomes and follow-up periods differed.
statement_zh: 2016 年統合分析僅綜合短期結果，因為只有少數研究報告長期結果，且追蹤期間不一致。
